description.p: AETHONE routes the whole device or proxy-aware apps through Aether (WARP-class core) and zeptun (userspace TUN router) with MASQUE, WireGuard, VLESS-WS, Tor and Psiphon protocols.
While the tunnel is up the system proxy points at the same local SOCKS5 listener (GNOME gsettings + KDE kioslaverc), so browsers ride the tunnel too; the state is restored on disconnect.
The motion-design overhaul, a new protocol page and the Lantern core on Android; Telegram one-tap proxy rows, a scan-speed control for the Aether core (turbo by default) and settings polish.

The first Linux release of AETHONE: deb, rpm, AppImage, Flatpak and a portable tar.gz, all built from the same v1.0.1 source as the Android release. The system-proxy companion now covers GNOME (gsettings) and KDE Plasma (kioslaverc) desktops.
